reviews.review:
A good L4D type of coop/versus game. The enemies are identical or analogous to L4D.
The dialogues at the start of the episodes are pretty entertaining. During the game, characters will sometimes comment on the environment to provide background story.

One cool thing is game customization. You can give yourself infinite ammo, set the amount of special weapons spawns. it will quickly become too easy or too hard, but it's always nice to be able to tinker with gameplay.

Some of the levels are a little repetitive, walking through the same corridors. But there are also memorable ones, like going through the park full of grass and flowers with infinite horde.

The game is not very populated. I only managed to find a public game once, on a Sunday I think. 
There's a Discord server where they play a Versus game every week with a full team, but note they play at around 4 AM GMT. 

EDIT: Their Discord server members are not very mature, and people get easily pissed when you have different opinions. So ehm yea..

Souless l4d2 clone. At first glace the game looks kinda cool with its futuristic setting but the more you dive in the more you'll notice how bland it is. Also, playing it with bots it's such a pain, they either get stuck somewhere, rush into the middle of a hoard or try to save someone and end up on the ground instead. Though, sometimes the bots work perfectely fine. I assume if you have friends to play it with, it's a day and night difference. The game can be easily found for 50 cents on grey markets so for that price it's worth giving it a shot. Maybe you'll like it, sadly, I didn't.

A solid sci-fi L4D. Little rough around the edges, but still very enjoyable. Art and music is awesome and the characters are fun. Join the Discord! Lot's of friendly people and we try to schedule PVP & coop sessions at least once a week.
